title: Robot arm
what: An assembly with joints you can drive.
hint: In the full app, open Assemble > Drive Joints and turn the base, swing the shoulder, or bend the elbow.

title: A part with its feature history
what: A sketch with its dimensions and constraints, an extrude, and a fillet.
hint: In the full app, double-click the extrude in the History bar, change 10 to 25, and the part rebuilds.

title: Counterbored block
what: Two sketches, a pad, and a counterbored hole, with verified editable history.
hint: In the full app, inspect Pad and Hole in the History bar. Geometry was verified against the source; one sketch symmetry constraint was omitted.

title: Raised pad
what: Two sketches and two additive extrudes, with verified editable history.
hint: In the full app, inspect Pad and EmbossPad in the History bar. Geometry was verified against the source; one symmetry constraint per sketch was omitted and four parameters were renamed.
